units.source_text: 突然间，我回忆起我们村庄所发生的悲剧性的事件。

en.t: All at once, I remembered the tragic incident that had occurred in our village.

units.source_text: 实际上这一事件与我毫不相干，可不知怎的，我总觉得与我有关，我参与了，

en.t: In reality, the incident had nothing at all to do with me, but somehow I always felt that it concerned me, that I had taken part in it,

units.source_text: 这种实际的感觉是无法消失的。

en.t: and that vivid sense of reality could not be made to disappear.
